import subprocess, os, glob

pages = set\(\)
for match in re.findall\(r"['\\"]\([^'\\"]+\)['\\"]", result.stdout\):

            rel = os.path.join\(root, f\)[len\(base\)+1:].replace\(".tsx", ""\)

unreferenced = sorted\(tsx_files - pages\)

    print\(f"  {p}"\)

    print\(f"  {p}"\)

print\(f"Total .tsx page files: {len\(tsx_files\)}"\)

print\(f"Unreferenced .tsx files: {len\(unreferenced\)}"\)
PYEOF)
